# sprint labels groups save

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint labels groups save — Workflow settings use current team revision; scoped templates and label groups enforce current permissions.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint labels groups save --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Workflow settings use current team revision; scoped templates and label groups enforce current permissions.

EXAMPLES
  sprint labels groups save --file input.json --operation-key KEY

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION
  --operation-key KEY
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  The example input.json creates a new record without id; --operation-key is required. To update, include id and the current --expected-revision.
  API action: workflow.saveLabelGroup
  JSON input for --json-data/--file: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"teamId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"projectId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["single","multiple"]}},"required":["name","mode"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
